title: Exact unbiased native coarsening with a sharp residue codec
body:
A Gaussian native child can accept a fine grid and return a **pointwise minimum-variance unbiased coarse-grid output**, with an exact inverse from its retained seed and residue. For `N=512^f`, `a=r*f` active axes and grid ratio `2^k` with `k>=ceil(a/2)`, the codec uses exactly **`2*k*N` retained bits** and one fresh uniform seed of **`k+ceil(a/2)` fair bits**. Both information counts are sharp in the stated classes. This is a numerical interface and representation codec; **no new complete kappa, physical reversible circuit or selected assumption discharge is claimed.**

Review the [proof, quotient construction and complete direct invoice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5f7c893b6af9a75cb19ad22c6db06ed22eea6f54/research/native-coarse-grid-residue-codec/PROOF.md), [executable codec](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5f7c893b6af9a75cb19ad22c6db06ed22eea6f54/research/native-coarse-grid-residue-codec/codec.py), [generated certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5f7c893b6af9a75cb19ad22c6db06ed22eea6f54/research/native-coarse-grid-residue-codec/RESULT.json), [verification](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5f7c893b6af9a75cb19ad22c6db06ed22eea6f54/research/native-coarse-grid-residue-codec/verify.py) and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5f7c893b6af9a75cb19ad22c6db06ed22eea6f54/research/native-coarse-grid-residue-codec/SOURCES.json). Reviewed head: `5f7c893b6af9a75cb19ad22c6db06ed22eea6f54`. Base: canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, selected [PR6030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6030).

The interface is A=L C_r R with the actual Gaussian-unit monomial phases. Input `x` represents `h*x/2^k`; output `q` represents `h*q`. Given a fresh uniform integer u below D=2^(k+ceil(a/2)), every real component is rounded by

```text
q_j = floor((n_j+u)/D), where n = 2^ceil(a/2) A x.
```

One seed serves the entire field; coordinate errors need not be independent. The exact conditional mean is the ideal native output. The mean squared error is the sum of the scalar adjacent-grid variances and is at most `N*h^2/2`. An integer-valued random output with the same means cannot have a smaller sum. This is not a minimum deterministic-error claim.

The explicit Gaussian quotient is `Z[i]^N / (2^k A^-1 Z[i]^N)`. Integral triangular transforms reduce it to pi-adic coordinate widths `2*k-a+2*weight`, totaling `2*k*N` bits. For every fixed seed and coarse output, exactly `2^(2*k*N)` fine-grid inputs occur. A byte-packed residue code labels them, and a literal inverse recovers the input. Finite arbitrary dirty storage cannot reduce the required retained-label capacity. **This optimum is for the advertised full fine grid; it is not a hardware clean-bit minimum or a lower bound on correlated caller states.** The seed lower bound concerns fixed-length fair-bit sampling, not entropy or expected variable-length cost.

The [selected word](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a/research/p104-helper470-twin-rung-removal/WORD.json.gz) has 3,453 MOVE events and 2,886 distinct directed edges. Its complete frame ledger passes. The rank census is independently checked by Pauli/tableau composition and by 18-bit matrix inversion/composition with finite-span ranks. For each of the eight present ranks, the [unchanged compiler](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a/research/staged544-mixed-fourth-entry/native/vendor/native/new/code/borrow/vendor/clifford/clifford_exact.py), [separate coordinate oracle](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a/research/staged544-mixed-fourth-entry/native/vendor/native/new/code/borrow/bw_gauss.py) and new interpreter agree on all 512 columns of the first representative. The other 2,878 edge recipes are not instantiated here.

At f=1, k=5 matches the h/32-to-h grid ratio in [PR6499](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6499) and [PR6506](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6506). Each full-grid codec uses 5,120 retained bits and 6–9 seed bits. One slot per MOVE totals 17,679,360 retained bits and 21,683 separate fresh seed bits. These are uncompressed proposed slots, not a complete invoice or joint entropy lower bound. The predecessors' error constants are not imported. At larger tensor widths the rank-eight class needs `k>=4*f` under this codec; fixed k=5 is not an all-width admission.

Validation uses CPython 3.12.13 and NumPy 2.3.4:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-coarse-grid-residue-codec
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/native-coarse-grid-residue-codec --check-source-history
```

Normal and optimized registered runs pass. Checks cover 25,184 complete quotient endpoints, 16 retained-bit witnesses, 36 separate dense-tensor oracle fixtures, 432 small seed round trips, 4,096 source columns in each of two interpreters, 128 signed native round trips, 64 arbitrary coarse-output/residue endpoints and exact moments over all 1,920 seeds. All four seeds of a 262,144-coordinate tensor fixture pass with a 524,288-bit label. Eleven semantic/domain controls and three actual source-corruption rejections pass. The source compiler/oracle run unchanged with assertions enabled in a normal subprocess in both modes.

```text
PASS_NATIVE_COARSE_GRID_RESIDUE_CODEC
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/native-coarse-grid-residue-codec outcome=completed
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES
```

Thirteen committed package/input files, source ancestry and official export integrity pass. A read-only, Git-free optimized export replay passes in 21.29 seconds with all 14 exported files and modes unchanged. Hosted CI is pending at publication. No predecessor full scientific suite, selected cold replay, all native instances, independent human acceptance or proof-kernel review ran.

The complete direct round trip pays three native evaluations, `3*a*N/2` butterflies, `a*N` triangular pair updates, eight tensor monomial passes with `f` address digits each, and `2*k*N` digits in each codec direction. The proof includes copies, shifts, signed widths, buffers and `O((a+k+f)*N*(w+a+k+f))` indexed bit work. Sampling/seed access, residue lifetimes and cleanup, reversible gates, physical routing, fixed multitape schedules, accelerated recursive pricing and full caller/outer closure remain open. The residue cannot be erased from the coarse output alone. All five framework assumptions remain unchanged.

Credit Dugongue's [PR5815](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5815) and [Gaussian Smith factorization](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a/research/gaussian-exceptional-correction/consumer-construction.md), Ali Romman's [PR5821](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5821) execution, and Nick Petalas / @petalas for [PR5880](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5880)'s distinct [modular overwrite capacity](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a/research/gaussian-smith-reversible-capacity/PROOF.md), [PR6438](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6438)'s ensemble question and [PR6418](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6418)'s reuse analysis. [PR6066](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6066) and [PR6068](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6068) retain scalar residue and fair-bit denominator credit. [PR6532](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6532) supplies the prior same-grid native interface and its relative-error boundary.

DreamingOfClouds / @DreamingOfClouds supplied the selected word. Cinna Davis / @1337isnot1337 supplied [PR4088](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4088) and [PR2226](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2226)'s consumed native representations. [NOTICE](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5f7c893b6af9a75cb19ad22c6db06ed22eea6f54/research/native-coarse-grid-residue-codec/NOTICE) preserves the full native/compiler, Gaussian, scalar and precision lineage. Classical rounding, Smith factors and counting are not claimed as new. The new contribution is the explicit coarse-period codec, its scoped optima, source bindings and complete direct invoice.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19365675). Main and complete public open/closed PR and Discussion metadata were refreshed. A second exact-main README/TASK search found no matching unbiased coarsening/quotient description. The cited work and [PR2730](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2730)/[PR3467](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3467) mixed-grid/entrance contracts were inspected. No same claimed interface was found; arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain limits. No other contribution was edited.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0. Ten files are added only under `research/native-coarse-grid-residue-codec/`. The next unreserved step is a full caller error and retained-information schedule with its paid physical and all-width costs. No merge, closure or frontier change is requested.
